(A) Process A B (P) Internal energy decreases.
(B) Process BC (Q) Internal energy increase.
(C) Process CD (R) Heat is lost.
(D) Process DA (S) Heat is gained.
(T) Work is done on the gas.

Process, B C,

It is a isochoric process.

V = constant, P T

PC < PB TC < TB

U = nCVT = ve

Hence, internal energy decreases.

W = 0, Q = U = ve

Hence, heat is lost.

Process C D,

It is a isobaric process.

P = constant, V T

VD > VC TD > TC

U = nCVT = +ve

Hence internal energy increases.

Q = nCPT = +ve

Hence, heat is gained.

W = nRT = +ve

Hence, work is done by the gas.

Process, D A

According to ideal gas equation

Hence, it is a isothermal process.

VA < VD

W = ve, hence work done is done on the gas.
